---
name: New measurement
about: Propose a measurement for PCETbase (or open a pull request directly, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
labels: new-data
---

**Compound / partner / solvent:**

**Source:** DOI, year; table/page/figure of each value

**Measured quantities as published:** potentials with their reference electrode (E_raw, E_raw_ref), pKa values with their reference acid/base, BDFE as published (BDFE_pub), uncertainties and their kind (sigma_type)

**Conditions:** electrolyte, temperature (T_K), pH convention for aqueous data; inequalities as printed (bounds); caveats (flags)

See CONTRIBUTING.md for required fields. Every number needs its unit; potentials need their reference scale.
